# Material usage template API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

A reusable template that prefills a new material usage.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/materialusagetemplate/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/modules/materialusagetemplate/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `materialusagetemplate` (detail, create, update), `materialusagetemplates` (list)
- **Permissions:** inherited through `procedure_template.projects` or `specimen_procedure_template.projects` or `experimental_interface_template.projects` (from [`project`](/api/stem/project/))
- **Schema payload:** `type` selects a [MaterialUsage type](/api/schemas/materialusage/); send its fields in `details_json` (responses return them as `details`). `details_schema_version` is set by the server; do not send it.

Form-only inputs (sent on create or update, not returned in responses):

- `source` **[required]**. Choices: `inventory`, `catalog`, `manual`. Choose a consumable or enter the planned material manually. A template plans the product, not the lot. Choose the consumable stock when you apply this template to a record.

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string; max 100 characters |
| `projects` | list of [`project`](/api/stem/project/) ids |
| `procedure_template` | [`proceduretemplate`](/api/modules/proceduretemplate/) id; nullable |
| `specimen_procedure_template` | [`specimenproceduretemplate`](/api/modules/specimenproceduretemplate/) id; nullable |
| `experimental_interface_template` | [`experimentalinterfacetemplate`](/api/modules/experimentalinterfacetemplate/) id; nullable |
| `consumable` | [`consumable`](/api/resources/consumable/) id; nullable |
| `consumable_supplier` | computed. Optional: narrow the catalog list to one supplier. |
| `manual_source` | JSON object **[write-only]** |
| `type` | one of the [MaterialUsage types](/api/schemas/materialusage/) **[required]** |
| `type_display` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `stage_template` | `modules.procedurestagetemplate` id; nullable |
| `order` | number **[required]** |
| `details` | JSON object **[read-only]** |
| `notes` | string; max 500 characters |
| `details_schema_version` | string **[set by the server]** |
| `source_tier` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `source_tier_display` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `source_identity` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `summary` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `detail_summary` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `created_at` | datetime **[read-only]**; nullable |
| `updated_at` | datetime **[read-only]** |
| `user` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[read-only]** |
| `user_display` | computed **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/materialusagetemplate/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('materialusagetemplate', load_all=True)
records = resp['materialusagetemplates']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('materialusagetemplate', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.materialusagetemplates;
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/materialusagetemplate/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('materialusagetemplate', data={"type": "ActiveAgent", "order": 1, "details_json": {"...": "the fields of the selected MaterialUsage type"}, "source": "catalog", "consumable": "<consumable-id>"})
record = resp.json()['materialusagetemplate']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('type', 'ActiveAgent', 'order', 1, 'details_json', struct(), 'source', 'catalog', 'consumable', '<consumable-id>'), 'materialusagetemplate');  % struct() stands for the fields of the selected type
record = created.materialusagetemplate;
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/materialusagetemplate/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('materialusagetemplate', id='<id>', data={"name": "Material usage template 1 (renamed)"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'name', 'Material usage template 1 (renamed)'), 'materialusagetemplate', 'method', 'patch');
```

- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/materialusagetemplate/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

```

```
